script_text: Stop, Aries — Saturn has locked Mars into your 1st House, and your 7th House Moon is demanding consequences right now. Saturn at 8 Aries sits on your ruling planet Mars at 5 Aries in your 1st House of Self, squaring your 7th House Moon and forcing you to either grow up or face isolation. If single, Venus conjunct the Sun in your 5th House of Romance draws a deeply creative soul toward you — choose honesty. If taken, that Mars-Saturn square sparks a dangerous power struggle; withdraw before it explodes. Mercury trine Jupiter activates your 10th House of Career — a conversation today may secure your next role. Guard your finances carefully; your 2nd House of Income is unstable. Don't prove yourself through force — Saturn in your 1st House demands your fire become discipline, not aggression. Subscribe so you don't miss what unfolds next week.
